description: Java class that provides methods to create expression resolvers for various message types (incoming, outgoing, external messages, signals) within the Eclipse Ditto connectivity messaging service. The class focuses on managing placeholders and resolver creation for message processing.

classes.name: Resolvers
classes.description: Utility class for creating expression resolvers based on message and signal data, managing placeholders and their resolvers.

methods.name: getPlaceholders
methods.description: Returns an array of all placeholders used for message address and header mappings.

methods.name: forOutbound
methods.description: Creates an expression resolver for an outbound message based on the provided external message and connection ID.

methods.name: forSignal
methods.description: Creates an expression resolver for a given signal and connection ID.

methods.name: forExternalMessage
methods.description: Creates an expression resolver for an external message received by the system.

methods.name: forOutboundSignal
methods.description: Creates an expression resolver for a mappable outbound signal.

methods.name: forInbound
methods.description: Creates an expression resolver for an inbound external message, associating it with the respective signal and context.
